title: sedlink: sediment connectivity index and fluvial network analysis in Rust
description: Rust engine that computes the Index of Connectivity (Borselli et al. 2008 / Cavalli et al. 2013), fluvial network metrics (Strahler order, stream magnitude, longitudinal profiles), and sediment routing with distance-decay and IC-based sediment delivery ratios, from a DEM over D8 or D-infinity flow networks. Includes a cross-implementation parity harness against an independent NumPy reference.
